description: This file defines the 'Spots' class for SuiteCRM, extending Basic, including methods for handling configuration, localization, and security features specific to the module.

classes.name: Spots
classes.description: Represents the Spots module with properties and methods for configuration, localization, and security.

methods.name: bean_implements
methods.description: Indicates if the class implements a specific interface, e.g., 'ACL'.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_detail_fields
methods.description: Populates additional detail fields, including processing the 'config' property.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes and saves the Spots configuration, including localization and key-label translation.

methods.name: replaceKeyValueWithLabel
methods.description: Replaces config keys with localized labels for language-agnostic display.

methods.name: getKeysForLabels
methods.description: Retrieves keys corresponding to given labels for translation purposes.

methods.name: logSpotsErrorWithKeyMatching
methods.description: Logs an error when duplicate or missing label matches are detected.

methods.name: getKeyForLabel
